trial_court: Principal Senior Civil Judge, Tenali, HMOP.no.33 of 2017
case_name: Dokku Sujatha vs Dokku Jagadish Babu
facts_of_case: Petitioner-husband filed HMOP for divorce; respondent-wife filed IA for interim maintenance @ Rs.10,000/- per month from desertion date; trial court partly allowed wife's petition and granted interim maintenance @ Rs.1,500/- per month.

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance awarded in matrimonial proceedings is adjustable against the amount awarded and cannot be given over and above the same.
legal_principles.held: In the decision in Sangeeta v. State of Jharkhand [AIR 2018 JHARKHAND 57] Jharkhand High Court held that the wife who is getting a maintenance of Rs.5,000/- as per an interim order passed in MC under Section 125 of CrPC cannot again claim interim alimony under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
cited_cases: Sangeeta v. State of Jharkhand, (2018) AIR JHARKHAND 57

legal_principles.principle: A wife's maintenance claim should be considered in the light of her actual earning capacity and not just her present circumstances.
legal_principles.held: The wife is capable of working and earning; but, she is intentionally sitting idle.

outcome.final_order: Trial court order upheld: interim maintenance of Rs.1,500/- per month from date of filing HMOP till disposal.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in family law disputes
